random.name: random
random.description: Reused from ecoli_ciprofloxacin. Stratified, patient-grouped random split of ['DRIAMS-A']: test 20.1%, validation 10.0% of the samples (requested 20% / 10%), seed 42.
notes: Same partition as the 'random' split of dataset ecoli_ciprofloxacin: every sample keeps its part.

[ecoli_ciprofloxacin] Group IDs are only valid within one DRIAMS-A year folder (patient_no is re-hashed per year), so a patient seen in two years can be in two parts; compare with the within_year split.
93 sample(s) are not in ecoli_ciprofloxacin and are left out.
2149 sample(s) are not used by the reference split and are left out.

within_year.name: within_year
within_year.description: Reused from ecoli_ciprofloxacin. Stratified, patient-grouped random split of ['DRIAMS-A'], year folder 2017 only: test 20.0%, validation 10.0% of those samples (requested 20% / 10%), seed 42.
notes: Same partition as the 'within_year' split of dataset ecoli_ciprofloxacin: every sample keeps its part.

[ecoli_ciprofloxacin] Only year folder 2017 (1833 samples); patient IDs are consistent within it, so patient groups are complete. Differences to the random split estimate how much cross-year patient overlap affects the random split.
93 sample(s) are not in ecoli_ciprofloxacin and are left out.
4569 sample(s) are not used by the reference split and are left out.

temporal.name: temporal
temporal.description: Reused from ecoli_ciprofloxacin. By acquisition_date at ['DRIAMS-A']: train < 2017-10-01 <= validation < 2018-01-01 <= test.
notes: Same partition as the 'temporal' split of dataset ecoli_ciprofloxacin: every sample keeps its part.
[ecoli_ciprofloxacin] Removed 0 validation and 56 training sample(s) whose patient group also occurs in a later part.
[ecoli_ciprofloxacin] Patient groups are only valid within one year folder; cross-year overlap cannot be detected.
93 sample(s) are not in ecoli_ciprofloxacin and are left out.
2205 sample(s) are not used by the reference split and are left out.

external.name: external
external.description: Reused from ecoli_ciprofloxacin. Train/validation on ['DRIAMS-A'], external test on ['DRIAMS-B', 'DRIAMS-D'] (validation 10.0% of the training-site samples, requested 10%, seed 42).
notes: Same partition as the 'external' split of dataset ecoli_ciprofloxacin: every sample keeps its part.
[ecoli_ciprofloxacin] Patients cannot be linked across hospitals, so cross-site patient overlap is not checked.
